DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 63 s. 2022 JUL 25 2022 HON. LIMUEL GABRIEL B. DONATO Sangguniang Bayan Member San Luis, Aurora Dear SB Member Donato. This pertains to your letter dated 10 June 2022 requesting for a conduct of a special election for the position of President in the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan in the Municipality of San Luis, Province of Aurora. Per your letter, you were the elected SK Pederasyon President of the Municipality of San Luis. The Vice President of the said SK Pederasyon resigned last November 2021 , however, there was no appointment in the said position that was made. Hence, to date, the Vice President position is still vacant. During the May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections you filed your Certificate of Candidacy for the position of Sangguniang Bayan Member, and was proclaimed the winner. Considering the vacancy in the position of President, you are now requesting this Department to conduct a special election for the position of SK Pederasyon President to fill the said position. Foremost, the existing vacancies in the President and VP positions should be filled up in accordance with the Internal Rules of Procedure (IRP) of the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga SK of San Luis, Aurora, pursuant to Item V, Section 23(1)(2) of the DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-011, viz: "Formulate and adopt its own Internal Rules of Procedures (IRP) which shall prescribe a set of rules to serve as guidelines of the Pederasyon Officers and the Committees in the discharge of their official functions, duties and responsibilities, particularly on intemal organization; date, time and venue of regular or special session or meeting; parliamentary procedures; payment of pederasyon dues and such other rules and regulations that may be adopted by the pederasyon that are not contrary to existing laws, ordinance, this JMC and other govemment issuances. " Special election as stated in Section 41 (a)(4) JMC is not applicable in the case at hand as it contemplates a situation where the vacancy is by virtue of the incumbent Vice President's automatic assumption of the position of President, because of the President's resignation, death, incapacity, removal from office or absence without leave. In the case herein, the Vice President himself resigned. 1 Entitled. "GUIDELINES ON THE CONDUCT OF SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN (SK) PEDERASYON ELECTION; AND RULES GOVERNING TERMS OF OFFICE, SUSPENSION AND REMOVAL OF ALL SK PEDERASYON OFFICERS" "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

Accordingly, the conduct of the election to fill up the vacancy in the positions of President and Vice President should be in accordance with the IRP of the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga SK of San Luis, Aurora. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: 'Ijl',r, , GAN Undersec tary for Local Government LLLS/RPB/LRALLD/rrao/clp copy furnish: DIR. KARL CAESAR R.
